access_boundary: This record represents the March 2025 Mistral Small 3.1 release at Hugging Face commit 68faf511d618ef198fef186659617cfd2eb8e33a (last modified 2025-12-22). Its mistral-small-2503 API line retired on November 30, 2025 with migration directed at Mistral Small 4. The Small 3.2 successor, other Mistral lines, and community quantizations remain separate boundaries.
strengths: Ungated 24B multimodal checkpoint under a declared Apache-2.0 grant with vision examples
Release, retirement, and replacement all dated on first-party docs
tradeoffs: No LICENSE file ships beside the weights; the grant rests on card and docs declarations
